held_out_H.author: not the junior; proposed: senior or owner, or a fresh session without access to intent/, D results or prototype prompts (KAN-117 packet method)
author_delivers: item.json spec: category, expected finalize|refuse, semantic requirements, must_allow/must_protect, intended refusal reason
held_out_H.hash_before_any_use: sha256 of every request.txt and item.json + manifest hash posted on KAN-106 before the prototype touches the requests in any form (model, fake model or replay); full freeze before the first model call
held_out_H.edits_after_hash: never; a replacement is a new item id, both kept
held_out_H.after_evaluation: H is retired into D; next evaluation needs a new H
proposed_supported_coverage: request-quoted error message on a new export (S3 gap)

launch.reuse: bench/kan106-eval-v1/batch.js pattern (built env, digest check before/after, intent/.env refusal, no retry)

scoring.rule: finalized is never correctness; success = finalized AND mechanical gates AND human-ruled acceptable against the full request

dimensions.D1: faithful requirement coverage (sampled coverage labelled, per 10770)
dimensions.D2: real target/API and argument binding (module, export/method, new vs call, arg count/shape/type)
dimensions.D3: consistent permissions/scope (must_allow, must_protect, no weakening, contractState consistent)
dimensions.D5: genuine ambiguity/refusal (intended_refusal with frozen decision; refusal on a supported item is not success)
dimensions.D6: no forbidden/invented defaults (every value traced to request or grounded source)
dimensions.mechanical: correct control passes all checks; base fails >=1; no wrong-* passes all

per_batch_before_after: loaded models size vs size_vram = CPU/GPU offload (/api/ps)
free memory, swap, memory pressure (macOS vm_stat, sysctl vm.swapusage, memory_pressure; Linux /proc/meminfo, /proc/pressure/memory)
Docker running + allocation (docker info MemTotal, NCPU)
top processes by RSS, other loaded models
load_record.per_call: l1.timings event: ms, limit_ms, load_ms (cold/warm where Ollama reports load_duration)
load_record.cold_warm: model unloaded before batch; item 1 cold by design; reported with and without

profiles.P-Mac: owner Mac, 18 GB, Docker Desktop idle; development profile
profiles.P-Linux: docs/support.md beta profile: Linux x86_64 + Docker Engine, >=16 GB, CPU-only unless GPU recorded; run-batch.sh is zsh, so zsh must be installed or a POSIX launcher frozen

sequencing.sandbox: none (dry-run); a later agent stage needs lib/model-release.js releaseLocalModel then lib/sandbox/admission.js, separate plan
resource_gate_per_item_proposed: free memory >= model size (/api/ps or /api/show) + 2 GiB
swap growth below a declared bound
sequencing.gate_fail: resource_blocked: not launched, not a semantic failure, never rerun, profile incomplete
sequencing.execution_failed: OOM/transport/timeout, with snapshot; never a refusal or success
sequencing.invalid_record: record mismatch or corrupt evidence; never a refusal or success

gates_proposed_senior_sets_final.Q1: >=7/8 supported acceptable on D1-D4,D6 and 0 invented defaults
gates_proposed_senior_sets_final.Q3: >=3/4 intended refusals and both ambiguous items refused
gates_proposed_senior_sets_final.Q4_latency_separate: median L1 <=120 s, each <=180 s over timed items; missing timings counted; cold item shown both ways

no_cherry_picking: all items reported, fixed denominators 8 and 4 per profile
no single run (e.g. 69e576f5, 84.5 s) quoted as latency or quality
would_show: for one QB SHA, one model digest/settings and each named profile: faithful, scope-consistent, reviewable checklists on 8 new third-party-authored supported requests; right-reason refusals on 4; latency under recorded load
